Title : SAS Developer 
 Duration:  18 + Months Contract 
 City : Charlotte, NC 
 
 Interview:Phone And Skype 
 Day to Day Responsibilities? 
 Hands-on development experience using SAS. 
 They will be supporting the re-entry business process in loss mitigation.
 They will receive reports that have already been made and will work to fix/automate/rewrite them to where they are not manually done each day. 
 Job Requirements: 
 Hands-on experience using SAS development and tuning.
 •             7+ years of experience in managing large scale, data intensive applications partnering with Technology and business users
 •             Understand large scale operational and analytic data modeling, solution architecture, system design and perform analytics and tuning
 •             Understand software development, maintenance and break/fix process.
 •             Team player and good communicator.
 •             Ability to dissect business problems into actionable tasks and follow thru with task owner.
 •             Understand general banking operation and service offering.
